notes: Current policy: only owner-authored first-party training data is permitted. All third-party dataset entries below are historical source-review records and are prohibited for download, preparation and training. The internal AETHRION-SAFE authoring track remains first-party but still requires creation and independent human review.

public_metadata_review.finding: Official Mozilla Data Collective catalogue lists Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 Turkish (tr), ASR, CC0-1.0, MP3, 2.79 GB. Direct Hugging Face inspection found the legacy mozilla-foundation/common_voice_17_0 dataset empty with a notice that Common Voice datasets moved exclusively to Mozilla Data Collective effective October 2025; the candidate v27 HF repo ID was not found. Therefore the official MCD catalogue is the current discovery/download source; this does not establish speaker-level provenance/consent or authorize training.
public_metadata_review.next_gate: Do not ingest, download or train on this third-party dataset under the current first-party-only policy.

owner_approval.scope: Owner-authored first-party data only: private local source preparation, documented authorship and rights, human review, and training only after the exact owner-authored dataset passes every gate.
owner_approval.note: The project owner authorizes training only on owner-authored first-party data after source, rights, privacy, quality and human-review gates pass. No third-party dataset is authorized for download or training. This does not create data, grant rights, accept provider terms, authorize paid acquisition or paid compute, or satisfy speaker consent.
